## Request
Assess refinancing and liability-management risk for **TransDigm Group Incorporated**, as of **2024-09-30**, on the covenant_refinancing pathway: what matures, what resources can meet it, what refinancing would cost, creditor positioning and feasible funding paths.

**Status: Restricted historical assessment; complete refinancing quantification is not supportable.** The supplied liquidity handoff lacks a forward run-rate flow, minimum cash and facility-level amortization schedule. The legal handoff is Blocked. Historical financing execution is evidenced, but prospective funding commitments and legal liability-management capacity are not. This handoff completes the requested analytical registers with explicit gaps rather than manufacturing a funding deficit, cost estimate or transaction permission.

Issuer evidence is upstream only. Underlying filing locators below are inherited lineage, not new source verification or quotations. No external sources were used. The annual filing retrospectively reports the measurement date; the inherited audit date is November 7, 2024, and the information cutoff is Not supplied. October events remain subsequent events. No claim of point-in-time public availability, whole-filing review or visual verification is made.

### Funding gap view
A definitive funding gap is **Not calculable**. Reported cash plus revolver availability of USD 7,104 million exceeds the supplied subtotal of declared distributions and one-year contractual obligations of USD 6,501 million by USD 603 million. That inherited residual excludes forward operating generation and significant other flows and is not verified accessible liquidity. It cannot establish either a financing deficit or a safely available buffer. The immediate documented cash reduction is the USD 4,348 million distribution settlement; the first dated funding-continuity task is receivables renewal on July 11, 2025. Beyond that, the reported fiscal-year schedule concentrates USD 6,637 million in FY2028. Complete maturity-date funding needs require a sequential, entity-aware cash model, not repeated use of the same reporting-date cash balance.

The specified method's resource equation is not itself an all-use cash forecast. For this issuer it must also be reconciled to the declared distribution: simply inserting reporting-date cash and a historical flow would fail to capture the separately scheduled extraction. Likewise, using an after-interest/tax flow and subtracting the same interest/taxes again would double count. The supplied liquidity handoff expressly leaves both forward flow and complete uses unresolved, so neither error is embedded in a published need.

The adverse causal sequence to test is weaker collections or delivery conversion, reduced receivables flexibility, increased revolver reliance and a renewal repayment competing with operations. No probability, covenant breach, security recommendation or recovery outcome is assigned.

## Calculations
### Conventions and formulas
All new arithmetic was executed with calculate using Decimal-38. Money is USD millions, currency USD, scale 1e6; gaps in money cells have the same unit. September 30, 2024 is the opening instant. FY2024 flows cover October 1, 2023–September 30, 2024. Source locators refer to the exact K artifact listed above through the named upstream facts. Copied observations and inherited calculations are not new calculations; analyst horizon and gap cells acquire no issuer citation or fabricated calculation identifier.

For each facility with known inputs:

- Amortization to date = minimum of principal and annual amortization × whole months / 12.
- Principal payable at maturity = principal less its capped amortization.
- Resources at maturity = cash + undrawn revolver − minimum cash + run-rate flow × whole months / 12 − capped amortization of every facility to that date − principal paid from resources at earlier maturities.
- Resources applied = minimum of principal payable and maximum of zero and resources.
- Refinancing need = principal payable − resources applied.
- Added annual cash interest = whole principal payable × step-up / 10000.
- Pro forma coverage = adjusted EBITDA / (cash interest paid + added interest).

Every ratio requires a positive denominator; adjusted EBITDA must also be positive for an economically meaningful earnings-based ratio. Missing step-up produces missing cost, not known zero. No monetary formula above was evaluated with missing operands replaced by zero. For this issuer, the separate distribution and other cash-use reconciliation must also be resolved before interpreting resource outputs as available cash.
